body:
## Purpose
Replace generic episilon presence conditionals that depend on the floating point type with fixed physical scales.

Improve robustness of some special functions.

## Content
Make `gamma_inc`, `gamma_inc_inv` AD-compatible, and reduce the `Float32` iteration count from 20 to 14 (tested that this is safe).

Add `guarded_quotient`, `nearest_admissible_b` and `clamp_to_nonneg` as the shared
primitives for presence tests and the rime density cone.

Remove `sgs_weight_function` (its functionality is replaced by `guarded_quotient`)

Make `DistributionTools` functions return `NaN` on invalid arguments rather than throwing a `DomainError` (which is not GPU-friendly). Impacts: `generalized_gamma_quantile`, `generalized_gamma_cdf`, `generalized_gamma_Mn`, `exponential_cdf`, and `exponential_quantile`.

Added docs to describe some of the changes in this PR.
title: Physics-scaled presence tests + AD-safe incomplete gamma
